terms.definition: The unit of work identified by KEY (e.g. PROJ-123), tracked in status.json's handoff directory.
One step of the pipeline's state machine (fetch, locate, plan, implement, …), transitioned through `ai-flow stage …`.
An Agent Skills document the host loads by name; carries judgement, never machine-readable state.
The agent runtime a skill executes under — Claude Code or Cursor.
The handoff file holding the stage state machine, referenced by its exact filename.
~/.ai-flow/<KEY>/, the ticket's own directory under the ai-flow home.
A versioned, pinned bundle of standards guidance and checks, layered org/team/repo.
A developer-confirmed, expiring exception to one check, recorded in <repo>/.ai-flow/waivers.json.
One OPS unit under change (a Terraform module, a Kustomize overlay, …), named in ops-targets.json.
The normalized, addon-independent representation of what a target's render would do — the output of an addon's DryRun capability.
The tool-specific package implementing the Addon interface for one infrastructure or CI tool (terraform, kubectl, helm, kustomize, github-actions, jenkins).
A recorded human approval in status.json (plan, impact, ship) that authorizes the pipeline to proceed.
